task.title: Apply the Workflows system UI criteria to the Flows library
task.objective: Bring the Flows library into visual parity with the completed Workflows library treatment while preserving every existing Flow action, permission gate, validation verdict, and persistence call.

architecture: Change the Flows library renderer only; preserve the app shell, route, preload API, FlowProfile schema, validation service, and main-process persistence.
Reuse the existing Hologram tokens, shared animated filter disclosure, system table surface, status pills, and page-chrome action system.
Keep the unavailable Flow importer visibly disabled with an explanatory tooltip; do not add a fake enabled action.
accessibility: Keep semantic table markup, aria-sort state, accessible action names, keyboard row opening, visible focus styles, responsive overflow, and reduced-motion behavior.
offline: Do not add remote assets, fonts, scripts, dependencies, or runtime network access.

acceptance.description: The Flows library uses the Workflows system design language: page-header actions, collapsed-by-default animated filters, a titled table surface with a record/status count, identity-led bold theme-text names, icon-led numeric cells, and token-driven status and validation cells.

Every existing Flow create, open, clone, export, delete, re-scan, permission, validation, filter, sort, and pagination path remains wired to its existing handler and preload channel; unavailable import remains explained and disabled.
The task records accurate AI-memory and roadmap evidence before terminal closeout.

2026-09-18: source review confirms the change is confined to FlowLibrary presentation and token CSS. Create, re-scan, open, clone, export, delete, validation, filtering, sorting, pagination, permission, and preload paths retain their existing handlers; Import Flow remains disabled and explained. Icon glyphs are decorative, action buttons are labelled, sortable headers retain aria-sort, the row remains keyboard-openable, and nested actions stop keyboard propagation so they do not also open the row.

2026-09-18: final focused review found and corrected nested keyboard-event ownership before closeout; Enter/Space on the name or row actions now performs only the chosen action. No remaining correctness, accessibility, token, permission, or scope finding was identified in the final diff.
